name: Ownkube

evidence.paas: 03: provider-hosted app containers with source builds and rolling releases; Ownkube runs them

line: Deploy container apps and databases on managed or own-cloud infrastructure.

free.text: No free hosted compute; own-cloud Starter still needs paid AWS resources

work.math: Listed month: Spark 1 at $5, plus 100 GB sent out ($2 Germany, $13 Mumbai) = $7 or $18. A $5 wallet load pays for usage once. 100 build minutes fit within 500. Image, log, repo and 730-hour pricing are unknown.

Listed month: Spark 3 ($19) + 100 GB sent out ($2 Germany, $13 Mumbai) = $21 or $32. 1 vCPU and 2 GiB meets the minimum, and 100 builds fit within 500. The 730-hour, image, log and repo costs are not confirmed.

Small app API + database 1 ($8) + $0.25 times storage. Germany: $29 + $0.25 times storage. Mumbai: $40 + $0.25 times storage. 10 GB same-region traffic is free. 10 GiB storage and backup schedule are unclear.
